headline: NVIDIA reports agent-steered Allen Telescope Array pipeline processing live radio data
summary: NVIDIA’s Oct 30 account describes AI agents steering the Allen Telescope Array while a Holoscan-based pipeline processes incoming radio data. NVIDIA reports capacity of 2.4 terabits per second on RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPUs and a real-time detection of the known Crab Nebula pulsar. These are vendor-reported system claims. Earlier peer-reviewed ATA work already reported real-time AI processing and Crab-pulsar giant-pulse detections, so the new post’s “first” wording should not be read as first-ever; it does not specify the narrower agentic-system scope.
